thesis.core: Bingshan has real industrial refrigeration, compressor, cold-chain, environmental simulation and specialized thermal-management operations, but the 2026 rebound narrative is not yet supported by durable recurring profit growth. Liquid-cooling products remain at trial/early marketing stage with only sporadic 2026 revenue, while A-share valuation already embeds material optionality.
thesis.variant_wedge: 2026 9M revenue RMB3.296bn -8.98%, attributable profit RMB61.31m -32.38%, deducted attributable profit RMB38.81m -50.99%, and ROE only 1.94%. Q3 standalone attributable profit +16.79% from a low base does not offset nine-month deterioration. Nine-month CFO RMB70.91m versus negative RMB14.19m restated prior year; cash capex RMB45.20m, but receivables grew to RMB1.826bn from RMB1.636bn despite revenue contraction. Company 2026-10-23 abnormal-trading notice explicitly says liquid-cooling revenue is sporadic and ice/snow venue revenue has not been recognized.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026 9M deducted attributable RMB38.81m (annualized RMB51.74m, or ~RMB0.061/share) as conservative recurring earnings cross-check, versus reported annualized RMB81.75m (~RMB0.097/share). Because low ROE makes PE highly unstable, value via common book equity per share ~RMB3.76 with conservative P/B scenarios; no speculative liquid-cooling earnings credited without customer revenue and margin proof.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: The firm has legitimate technology and end markets, but negative recurring-profit trend and low ROE fail the recovery-quality test. Q3 CFO improvement is positive, yet receivables and working capital require sustained collections. 2026 liquid-cooling and ice/snow projects cannot be treated as a proven new earnings pillar. A-share price implies >2x book and a very high multiple of normalized recurring earnings.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Low recurring ROE and an explicit issuer warning against capitalizing liquid cooling as a material 2026 business support book-value-based scenarios rather than a growth PE. Multiples 0.85-1.70x are analyst assumptions contingent on recovery; bull case is not a forecast of booked liquid-cooling sales.

catalysts: Two or more quarters of recurring revenue and deducted profit growth with rising normalized ROE.
Liquid-cooling customer orders and revenue are disclosed with meaningful commercial gross margin and cash conversion, rather than R&D/early promotion.
Receivable collection improves while operating cash flow after capex remains positive without reliance on working-capital timing.
Specialized industrial refrigeration and compressor businesses win profitable projects with stable repeat customers.
kill_thesis: Liquid-cooling revenue remains immaterial while the market capitalizes a full commercial scale-up.
Receivables continue rising despite flat or declining revenue, or new credit impairments consume cash and equity.
Normalized ROE remains below the required cost of equity and recurring profit continues to decline.
Cash flow recovery reverses or margin compression from input costs and competition persists.

evidence_gap.monitoring: Future commercial liquid-cooling revenue/margins remain uncertain, and cannot be assumed in base earnings.
